card.name: Small linking words in drug warnings
card.fires_on: Punctuation and small linking words such as commas, "of", "to" and "and" in drug label warnings. They sit right before a drug name, a reaction or a risk term, for example after "e.g., fluoxetine" or "increase the risk".

modes.label: Comma in drug lists
modes.description: A comma or "and" inside a list of example drugs in parentheses.

modes.label: Link before a reaction
modes.description: "of" or "to" right after "risk" or "hypersensitivity", before the named reaction or drug.
modes.example: may increase the risk<< of>> myopathy and rhabdomyol

modes.label: Opening bracket or gap
modes.description: A gap or opening quote mark right before a cross-reference or title.
modes.example: Permanently discontinue TYRUKO if such a reaction occurs. (<< >>5.5 )

card.plain: It fires on small joining words and commas in warnings, just before a drug or a side effect is named.
